newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: RESEARCH ALERT -CSFB reiterates Roche buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT -CSFB reiterates Roche buy.

text.p: Credit Suisse First Boston reiterated its buy recommendation for Roche Holding AG shares after a presentation by Roche unit Genentech last week.
"There are no spectacular new headlines on Genentech, in which Roche has a 68 percent stake, simply a continual series of positive events," it said in a research report.
"The Genentech presentation reinforces our trust in the Roche story and confirms our current forecasts for the company."
It said Roche was taking a "wait and see" approach on acquiring the minority stake it does not already own.

It based its positive review on what it called Roche's impressive pipeline of new drugs in final testing, agressive efforts to cut costs and improve margins and an unusually profitable vitamin business with unchallenged market leadership.
"It is expected that the combination of these factors will make the return on invested capital rise from 11.5 percent in 1996 to 15.1 percent in 2000, with comparable price advances."
